title: Strategic Innovation in Southeast Asia

Strategic Innovation in Southeast Asia

2026 ASPI-Schwarzman Scholars Alumni Conference

From June 10-11, 2026, Schwarzman Scholars alumni gathered with the Institute of Diplomacy and Foreign Relations (IDFR) Malaysia in Kuala Lumpur for a seminar hosted by the Asia Society Policy Institute (ASPI). The program featured 19 alumni from 13 countries who engaged in robust dialogues with invited speakers. Participants explored topics related to Malaysia's economic transformation and its expanding role in regional and global trade architecture. Across panels and roundtables, key themes included domestic transformation, regional integration, semiconductors and innovation, navigating global trade headwinds, and artificial intelligence (AI) and fintech. Inspired by these discussions, several alumni share their insights on Malaysia's rise as a regional and global tech hub.
